exposure: Peg IFN a-2a combined with Adefovir (CPIA) (postpartum)
cohort: The study participants were chronic hepatitis B pregnant women with normal levels of ALT and high levels of HBV DNA.
finding: High rates of viral response and clearance were achieved in chronic hepatitis B pregnant women with normal levels of ALT and high levels of HBV DNA treated by CPIA after childbirth.
followup_time: 96 weeks after childbirth (for the CPIA treatment group)
